title: Q3LOCK R-497 loop-limit authority-chain correction disposition

method: Recompute the pinned SHA-256 values for the EXP-000782 certificate, the P-06 total-variation correction audit, the R-497 manifest and the current manuscript.

boundary: T0 source-integrity audit only; R-497 remains claim_bearing=false, publication_status=RESEARCH_ONLY and pdf_status=DEFERRED. No theorem promotion, Sector A-F change, novelty or priority claim, submission or physical conclusion.
